editorial:
Imagine getting sucked into a crime spree just because you were in the wrong place at the wrong time. That is exactly what happens to Rory, who ends up paired with a chaotic guy named Cobby for a heist that goes south almost immediately. The vibe is light, fast, and full of panic. You get to watch these two total opposites try to survive while being chased by the cops and a scary crime boss. To make things even weirder, Rory's own therapist joins the group, adding a hilarious layer to the madness as they try to figure out how to stay alive.

The chemistry between the leads is the best part, making the dialogue feel snappy and real. While the plot is a bit predictable, the funny moments and quick pacing keep you from getting bored. If you enjoy movies where everything that can go wrong does go wrong, you will love this.
endingExplained: After a wild chase, the group manages to outsmart the crime boss and the corrupt officials. They use a clever trick to secure the money and ensure the bad guys take the fall for the crimes. Rory and Cobby end up forming an unlikely bond through their shared trauma. They finally get away clean, leaving the chaos behind them and starting over with a bit of cash and a lot of funny stories.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist comedies and chaotic duo dynamics.
